feature_additions.name: Hidden Weapons
feature_additions.description: May use Glamered Equipment during maintenance.

feature_additions.name: Gregarious Smith
feature_additions.description: May exchange a smithing insight for an eligible vigilante social talent.

feature_additions.name: Cold Iron Specialist
feature_additions.description: Uses full class level on the relevant Profession checks and treats crafted or modified equipment as cold iron when beneficial.

feature_additions.name: Recipes
feature_additions.description: Prepare a recipe with one entree and one flavor. It feeds the chef plus a number of allies based on Constitution; additional flavors and entrees unlock with level.

feature_additions.name: Chef's Insights
feature_additions.description: Chef insights are available whenever a smithing insight is gained.

feature_additions.name: Phantasmal Energy
feature_additions.description: Gain the Death sphere as a bonus magic talent.

feature_additions.name: Wraith Form
feature_additions.description: Become incorporeal for a limited number of rounds per day.

feature_additions.name: Elemental Conduit
feature_additions.description: Gain Conjuration and Destruction sphere access and designate a mage-archetype companion as the elemental conduit.

feature_additions.name: Destructive Capacitor
feature_additions.description: Channel destructive energy and temporary spell points into the elemental conduit.
